correction.corrected_body: W05 defines a real structure on CP1 as an antiholomorphic map rho: CP1 -> CP1 with rho squared equal to 1; ordinary complex conjugation rho([z1,z2])=[bar(z1),bar(z2)] is one such real structure, and its real points are exactly the points fixed by rho. W05 then defines the twistor real structure rho_tw by rho_tw([z1,z2])=[-bar(z2),bar(z1)] (equivalently rho_tw(z)=-1/bar(z)); on C2 coordinates rho_tw squared equals -1, while on projective points rho_tw squared equals 1 and rho_tw has no projective fixed points. W05 also presents the same twistor P1 as the real projective conic x^2+y^2+z^2=0 in projective two-space, defined over the real numbers, with complex points but no real points.
